COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated RDW, and increased ferritin, suggesting possible inflammation or infection. Elevated INR with low PT may indicate anticoagulation therapy or liver dysfunction. Creatinine and chloride are mildly elevated. Eosinophilia and basophilia are present. ALT is low. Findings warrant further clinical correlation for possible hypoxic, hematologic, renal, or inflammatory processes.
